title: Nifty, Sensex post early mild gains despite mixed global cues
description: Indian equity benchmarks opened marginally higher on Thursday, with Sensex rising 168 points and Nifty gaining 45 points despite mixed global cues, elevated crude oil prices, and concerns over US interest rates. IT and pharma stocks led gains, while private banks and media shares lagged.

title: Collector gives ‘thumbs up’ to Nizamabad venue for Khelo India TT event
description: Nizamabad Collector Ila Tripathi praised the infrastructure at Navyabharati Global School's sports complex after reviewing preparations for the Khelo India Youth Games table tennis event. She commended the school management for completing the facility in record time and said it reduced the administrative burden of creating new infrastructure.

title: Strong memory business powers Samsung to record third-quarter profit
description: Samsung Electronics reported a record third-quarter performance, driven by booming demand for AI-related memory chips. Net profit surged over six-fold year-on-year, while operating profit and revenue hit record highs, with the semiconductor division contributing nearly all of the company's operating earnings.

title: Telangana’s GI-tagged Tandur red gram makes export debut in Australia
description: APEDA facilitated the first-ever export of GI-tagged Tandur red gram from Telangana to Australia, marking a milestone for the State's agricultural exports. The 2.5-metric-tonne consignment was shipped from Hyderabad, opening new international market opportunities for farmers and producers of the GI-certified pulse from Vikarabad district.

title: Congress’ MLC poll rout proves politics, not EVMs, is the problem: Bandi Sanjay
description: Union Minister Bandi Sanjay Kumar mocked the Congress over its poor performance in the MLC elections, saying EVMs must be "laughing" at the party's allegations. Referring to the Congress drawing a blank in Karnataka and BJP's gains in Uttar Pradesh, he argued that the problem lies in the opposition's politics, not in electronic voting machines.

title: YSRCP slams Naidu over handling of Cyclone Arnab aftermath
description: YSRCP spokesperson Karumuri Venkata Reddy accused the Andhra Pradesh government of prioritising publicity over relief measures for people affected by Cyclone Arnab, alleging failures in evacuation, damage assessment and farmer assistance. He demanded immediate relief, compensation and restoration of essential services.

title: Trump backs Vivek Ramaswamy for Ohio governor at campaign rally
description: US President Donald Trump campaigned for Republican Ohio gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy at a rally in Chillicothe, urging voters to elect him governor. Ramaswamy promised major property-tax relief and action against sanctuary cities, aligning his campaign with Trump's "America First" agenda.

title: SC to hear Delhi-NCR pollution, stubble burning, green crackers cases today
description: The Supreme Court will hear matters on Thursday related to rising Delhi-NCR pollution, stubble burning and the sale of green firecrackers ahead of Diwali. While a complete ban on the manufacture, storage and use of firecrackers remains in force, the court had earlier allowed the production of green crackers without permitting their sale.

title: Netanyahu alleges Israeli election was ‘stolen’ by Arab-led parties
description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has alleged that the election was "stolen" by Arab-led parties, claiming voter fraud, bribery, intimidation and the use of illegal software. The accusations came after Arab-led parties Ra'am and the Joint List were projected to win a combined 19 seats.

description: Srikanth Odela | ‘దసరా’ సినిమాతో దర్శకుడిగా భారీ విజయాన్ని అందుకున్న శ్రీకాంత్ ఓదెల, నేచురల్ స్టార్ నానితో తెరకెక్కించిన ‘ది ప్యారడైజ్’తో ప్రేక్షకుల ముందుకు వచ్చారు. ఈ సినిమాపై విడుదలకు ముందు భారీ అంచనాలు నెలకొన్నప్పటికీ, థియేటర్లలో విడుదలైన తర్వాత ప్రేక్షకుల నుంచి విమర్శలు ఎదురయ్యాయి.

title: Nifty’s early comeback signal: Why largecaps are holding up as broader market slides
description: India’s equity market divergence suggests largecaps may be regaining leadership as mid- and smallcaps remain under pressure. The Nifty has recovered to broadly flat returns in October, while midcap and smallcap indices have declined. More reasonable valuations, earnings resilience, liquidity and institutional preference are supporting largecaps, though elevated crude prices, macroeconomic uncertainty and earnings concerns continue to cloud the broader market outlook.

title: Global Market: Samsung Electronics posts record $80.5 billion quarterly operating profit on AI chip boom
description: Samsung Electronics reported record quarterly operating profit of 107.4 trillion won, driven by surging AI memory chip demand. Despite strong earnings, shares fell over 5% amid concerns about semiconductor division performance and AI investment sustainability. Samsung also announced shareholder returns of up to 110 trillion won this year.

title: Global Market: South Korean shares fall 2% as Samsung Electronics slides after earnings

Losses extended across battery, automotive and steel stocks, despite foreign investor buying. Authorities pledged to monitor volatility. Meanwhile, the won strengthened 0.72%, and government bond yields declined amid market uncertainty and cautious investor sentiment.

title: Antala Industries SME IPO opens today: Check price band and key details

The packaging manufacturer reported strong FY26 growth, with total income rising 49% and profit after tax increasing 133%.
